summary: Scoped devlog append required the main workflow database path
details: The isolated audit worktree does not contain development/workflow.sqlite3, so the default devlog command could not open its database. The supplied scoped context and entry were then passed to the same development/devlog.py writer with the existing main development/workflow.sqlite3 path. The writer confirmed the append and queue_state_changed=false.
action: Used the canonical main workflow database with the assigned worker context; no queue state operation was requested.
outcome: The observation was appended as audit-g01-a1-cargo-tree-edge-flag.
